subject: Request: One-time commitment smoothing and temporary credit for burst capacity - HelioHealth
messages:
From: Anya Volk <anya@heliohealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary smoothing & one-time credit for burst months

Hi Marcus / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile. We're close to signing the SOW but one piece has come up on our end: forecasting for the next 6 months looks much bumpier than expected because of a pilot expansion. That creates headroom risk for us in month-to-month billing.

Two asks from procurement:
- A one-time smoothing credit that effectively spreads our expected excess over three months (May-Jul).
- A temporary surcharge waiver for burst capacity above 140% of committed tokens in a single month, capped at $25k.

I've attached the updated SOW with redlines (HelioHealth_SOW_v2.pdf). If Redwood can agree to either the smoothing or a capped surcharge waiver, we can sign by the end of the month. Otherwise procurement will need to push for an increased committed bucket.

Can you confirm feasibility and what internal approvals you'd need?

Best,
Anya
Anya Volk
Director, Strategic Sourcing
HelioHealth


From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Anya Volk <anya@heliohealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary smoothing & one-time credit for burst months

Anya — appreciate the clear ask and the updated SOW. Quick note to confirm receipt and next steps from our side:

- We're open to exploring a one-time smoothing credit as a sign-of-good-faith for a strategic pilot, but this requires VP/CFO signoff for any exceptions to standard billing.
- Alternatively, a capped surcharge waiver for up to $25k with a clear sunset/threshold is plausible; finance will want limits and a safety net.

Marissa — can you weigh in on precedent (pilot smoothing credits) and advise whether this needs VP or CFO approval?
Kimberly — looping you for a quick sensitivity check. I'll assemble a short memo for exec review if we think this should move forward.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: HelioHealth_SOW_v2.pdf (received)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: temporary smoothing & one-time credit for burst months

Thanks Marcus — this is exactly the sort of ask that should come with a concise escalation packet.

Quick guidance:
- Please prepare a one-page internal memo summarizing revenue impact, precedent, and a recommended structure (smoothing credit amount, cap, sunset date, and rollback triggers).
- Include a simple P&L delta (3-month view) and which billing product the credit applies to (hosted API tokens vs. dedicated capacity).
- If the net present value impact is > $15k we escalate to Markus (VP Finance/CFO); otherwise Kimberly can sign off.

I've attached a one-sheet template (deal_summary.xlsx) — use it to speed things along.

Marissa
VP, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: temporary smoothing & one-time credit for burst months

Marcus — added a quick sensitivity model (forecast_impact.xlsx) and some mandatory guardrails I will require before recommending escalation:

- Clear metric thresholds: smoothing applies only if monthly usage variance > 40% relative to baseline committed token volume.
- Cap the total one-time credit at 4% of the initial 12-month ARR for this deal, and no more than $25k in any case.
- Sunset clause: smoothing window ends after three billing cycles (60 days after the first smear month) and any overage after that reverts to standard rates.
- Precedent clause: this approval is explicitly non-precedential and limited to HL-2025-017 pilot.

If the calculated 3-month revenue impact is > $15k (per Marissa), I'll route to Markus for signoff. If not, I'll clear it. Please include the detailed numbers in the memo so I can review quickly.

- Kimberly
Finance Partner, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: forecast_impact.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Request for one-time commitment smoothing & capped surcharge waiver (HelioHealth — HL-2025-017)

Hi Markus —

As discussed with Sales and Finance, HelioHealth is asking for a short-term billing concession to bridge an unexpectedly spiky pilot expansion. This is time-sensitive; they will sign the SOW this week if we can confirm either: (A) a one-time smoothing credit across May–Jul, or (B) a capped surcharge waiver for bursts above 140% of committed tokens, capped at $25k.

Summary (one-paragraph):
HelioHealth requests either a smoothing credit (spread the first-month overage across 3 months) or a one-time capped waiver for burst usage. The customer is strategic in healthcare verticals and expanding pilot scope; concession would accelerate a $600k ARR opportunity with a twelve-month contracted commitment.

Numbers (3-month view):
- Baseline committed tokens: 120M tokens / month
- Projected burst month tokens (May): 180M tokens
- Incremental billed tokens without concession: 60M tokens (approx $18k)
- Recommended one-time smoothing credit: equal to spreading 60M tokens across May–Jul (reduces near-term revenue recognition by an estimated $12k over 3 months)
- Estimated 3-month revenue impact (smoothing): $12,000
- If surcharge waiver chosen, maximum exposure (capped): $25,000

Requested decision:
- If impact <= $15k, Kimberly will approve operationally. If > $15k, we need your signoff. By our calc it's ~ $12k, so Kimberly could clear, but given the strategic importance Marissa recommended you be aware.

Proposed guardrails (from Finance):
- Threshold: smoothing only if monthly variance > 40% vs baseline.
- Sunset: 3 billing cycles; no precedent beyond HL-2025-017.
- Reporting: require a post-pilot usage review and an explicit clause in the amendment that prevents automatic repeats.

Attachments: memo_vp_cfo.txt (internal one-page memo), deal_summary.xlsx, forecast_impact.xlsx.

Ask: Please reply with APPROVE or DECLINE (and any edits) by EOD tomorrow so we can commit to HelioHealth's signature timeline.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
